ModMetaData.name: Over Haulers - Weight Capacity Redefined
ModMetaData.author: Jay "iClustaFlux" Rogers
ModMetaData.description:
Dynamically overhauls Caravan Mass Capacity (max total inventory weight)
No more arbitrary caravan weight limits! Weight capacity scales dynamically depending on: - Pawn anatomy and physical condition - Prosthetic replacements and implants - Systemic health and stamina
No hard dependencies beyond Harmony.
100% Safe to add or remove mid-save.
